title: पञ्चचत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Dhritarashtra marvels at one boy fighting many warriors. Duryodhana's son Lakshmana rushes at Abhimanyu and is killed, and Duryodhana cries out to his warriors to slay Abhimanyu.
summary.kn: ಒಬ್ಬ ಬಾಲಕ ಅನೇಕ ವೀರರೊಡನೆ ಹೋರಾಡುವುದನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರ ಬೆರಗಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ. ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನ ಮಗ ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಣ ಅಭಿಮನ್ಯುವಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಎರಗಿ ಕೊಲ್ಲಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಅಭಿಮನ್ಯುವನ್ನು ಕೊಲ್ಲಿರೆಂದು ದುರ್ಯೋಧನ ಕೂಗುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: एक बालक के अनेक योद्धाओं से लड़ने की बात सुनकर धृतराष्ट्र चकित होते हैं। दुर्योधन का पुत्र लक्ष्मण अभिमन्यु पर टूटता है और मारा जाता है, और दुर्योधन योद्धाओं को अभिमन्यु को मारने के लिए पुकारता है।
summary.te: ఒక బాలుడు అనేక వీరులతో పోరాడటం విని ధృతరాష్ట్రుడు ఆశ్చర్యపడతాడు. దుర్యోధనుని కుమారుడు లక్ష్మణుడు అభిమన్యునిపై దూకి చంపబడతాడు; అభిమన్యుని చంపమని దుర్యోధనుడు అరుస్తాడు.
summary.ta: ஒரு சிறுவன் பல வீரருடன் போரிடுவதைக் கேட்டுத் த்ருதராஷ்டிரன் வியக்கிறான். துரியோதனன் மகன் லட்சுமணன் அபிமன்யுவைத் தாக்கிக் கொல்லப்படுகிறான்; அபிமன்யுவைக் கொல்லுங்கள் என்று துரியோதனன் கூவுகிறான்.
summary.ml: ഒരു ബാലൻ പല വീരന്മാരോട് പൊരുതുന്നത് ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രർ വിസ്മയത്തോടെ കാണുന്നു. ദുര്യോധനന്റെ പുത്രൻ ലക്ഷ്മണൻ അഭിമന്യുവിന്റെ നേർക്ക് പാഞ്ഞടുത്ത് വധിക്കപ്പെടുന്നു; അഭിമന്യുവിനെ കൊല്ലാൻ ദുര്യോധനൻ തന്റെ യോദ്ധാക്കളോട് ആർത്തുവിളിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.45; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
यथा वदसि मे सूत एकस्य बहुभिः सह ।
संग्रामं तुमुलं घोरं जयं चैव महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Charioteer, you describe a tumultuous, terrible battle of one man against many, and the victory of that great-souled one.

verses.text:
अश्रद्धेयमिवाश्चर्यं सौभद्रस्याथ विक्रमम् ।
किं तु नात्यद्भुतं तेषां येषां धर्मो व्यपाश्रयः ॥

meaning.en: Subhadra's son's prowess seems almost beyond belief, a marvel. Yet it is hardly strange in those who have righteousness as their refuge.

verses.text:
दुर्योधनेऽथ विमुखे राजपुत्रशते हते ।
सौभद्रे प्रतिपत्तिं कां प्रत्यपद्यन्त मामकाः ॥

meaning.en: When Duryodhana had turned away and a hundred princes were slain, what did my people do against Subhadra's son?

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
संशुष्कास्याश्चलन्नेत्राः प्रस्विन्ना लोमहर्षिणः ।
पलायनकृतोत्साहा निरुत्साहा द्विषज्जये ॥

meaning.en: With dry mouths, darting eyes, sweating and bristling with fear, they had lost heart for victory and wanted only to flee.

verses.text:
हतान्भ्रातॄन्पितॄन्पुत्रान्सुहृत्संबन्धिबान्धवान् ।
उत्सृज्योत्सृज्य समियुस्त्वरयन्तो हयद्विपान् ॥

meaning.en: Abandoning their slain brothers, fathers, sons, friends, in-laws and kinsmen again and again, they came on, urging their horses and elephants.

verses.text:
तान्प्रभग्नांस्तथा दृष्ट्वा द्रोणो द्रौणिर्बृहद्बलः ।
कृपो दुर्योधनः कर्णः कृतवर्माथ सौबलः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing them broken, Drona, Drona's son, Brihadbala, Kripa, Duryodhana, Karna, Kritavarman and Shakuni, all furious, rushed at the unconquered son of Subhadra.

verses.text:
अभिद्रुताः सुसंक्रुद्धाः सौभद्रमपराजितम् ।
तेऽपि पौत्रेण ते राजन्प्रायशो विमुखीकृताः ॥

meaning.en: But O king, your grandson turned most of them back as well.

verses.text:
एकस्तु सुखसंवृद्धो बाल्याद्दर्पाच्च निर्भयः ।
इष्वस्त्रविन्महातेजा लक्ष्मणोऽऽर्जुनिमभ्ययात् ॥

meaning.en: Then Lakshmana, raised in comfort, fearless through youth and pride, skilled with bow and weapons and of great fire, went alone against Arjuna's son.

verses.text:
तमन्वगेवास्य पिता पुत्रगृद्धी न्यवर्तत ।
अनु दुर्योधनं चान्ये न्यवर्तन्त महारथाः ॥

meaning.en: His father Duryodhana, devoted to his son, turned back after him, and other great chariot-warriors turned back following Duryodhana.

verses.text:
तं तेऽभिषिषिचुर्बाणैर्मेघा गिरिमिवाम्बुभिः ।
स च तान्प्रममाथैको विष्वग्वातो यथाम्बुदान् ॥

meaning.en: They drenched Abhimanyu with arrows as clouds drench a mountain with rain, but he alone scattered them, as a wind from every side scatters clouds.

verses.text:
पौत्रं तु तव दुर्धर्षं लक्ष्मणं प्रियदर्शनम् ।
पितुः समीपे तिष्ठन्तं शूरमुद्यतकार्मुकम् ॥

meaning.en: Your grandson Lakshmana, hard to overcome and fair to look on, stood near his father with his bow raised, a hero.

verses.text:
अत्यन्तसुखसंवृद्धं धनेश्वरसुतोपमम् ।
आससाद रणे कार्ष्णिर्मत्तो मत्तमिव द्विपम् ॥

meaning.en: Brought up in great luxury, like a son of the lord of wealth, he was met in battle by Krishna's nephew, as a rutting elephant meets another.

verses.text:
लक्ष्मणेन तु संगम्य सौभद्रः परवीरहा ।
शरैः सुनिशितैस्तीक्ष्णैर्बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पितः ॥

meaning.en: Meeting Lakshmana, Subhadra's son, slayer of enemy heroes, was struck by very sharp, keen arrows in the arms and chest.

verses.text:
संक्रुद्धो वै महाबाहुर्दण्डाहत इवोरगः ।
पौत्रस्तव महाराज तव पौत्रमभाषत ॥

meaning.en: O great king, enraged like a snake struck with a stick, your grandson Abhimanyu spoke to your other grandson.

verses.text:
सुदृष्टः क्रियतां लोको अमुं लोकं गमिष्यसि ।
पश्यतां बान्धवानां त्वां नयामि यमसादनम् ॥

meaning.en: "Take a good look at this world, for you are about to go to the next. I will send you to Yama's house while your kinsmen watch."

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा ततो भल्लं सौभद्रः परवीरहा ।
उद्बबर्ह महाबाहुर्निर्मुक्तोरगसंनिभम् ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, the mighty-armed Subhadra's son, destroyer of heroes, drew out a broad-headed arrow that looked like a snake shed of its skin.

verses.text:
स तस्य भुजनिर्मुक्तो लक्ष्मणस्य सुदर्शनम् ।
सुनसं सुभ्रु केशान्तं शिरोऽहार्षीत्सकुण्डलम् ।
लक्ष्मणं निहतं दृष्ट्वा हा हेत्युच्चुक्रुशुर्जनाः ॥

meaning.en: Loosed from his arm, that arrow took off Lakshmana's head, with its handsome nose, fair brows, hair and earrings. Seeing Lakshmana slain, the people cried out "Alas!"

verses.text:
ततो दुर्योधनः क्रुद्धः प्रिये पुत्रे निपातिते ।
हतैनमिति चुक्रोश क्षत्रियान्क्षत्रियर्षभः ॥

meaning.en: Then Duryodhana, the bull among kshatriyas, furious at the fall of his beloved son, shouted to the kshatriyas, "Kill him!"

verses.text:
ततो द्रोणः कृपः कर्णो द्रोणपुत्रो बृहद्बलः ।
कृतवर्मा च हार्दिक्यः षड्रथाः पर्यवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: Then six chariot-warriors surrounded him: Drona, Kripa, Karna, Drona's son, Brihadbala and Kritavarman, son of Hridika.

verses.text:
स तान्विद्ध्वा शितैर्बाणैर्विमुखीकृत्य चार्जुनिः ।
वेगेनाभ्यपतत्क्रुद्धः सैन्धवस्य महद्बलम् ॥

meaning.en: Arjuna's son pierced them with sharp arrows, turned them away, and swiftly fell furiously on the great force of the Sindhu king.

verses.text:
आवव्रुस्तस्य पन्थानं गजानीकेन दंशिताः ।
कलिङ्गाश्च निषादाश्च क्राथपुत्रश्च वीर्यवान् ।
तत्प्रसक्तमिवात्यर्थं युद्धमासीद्विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: Armoured men with a line of elephants blocked his path: the Kalingas, the Nishadas, and the valiant son of Kratha. O lord of men, the fighting there became very close.

verses.text:
ततस्तत्कुञ्जरानीकं व्यधमद्धृष्टमार्जुनिः ।
यथा विवान्नित्यगतिर्जलदाञ्शतशोऽम्बरे ॥

meaning.en: Then Arjuna's son joyfully shattered that elephant force, as the sun, ever moving, scatters hundreds of clouds in the sky.

verses.text:
ततः क्राथः शरव्रातैरार्जुनिं समवाकिरत् ।
अथेतरे संनिवृत्ताः पुनर्द्रोणमुखा रथाः ।
परमास्त्राणि धुन्वानाः सौभद्रमभिदुद्रुवुः ॥

meaning.en: Then Kratha's son covered Arjuna's son with showers of arrows, and the other chariot-warriors led by Drona turned back and rushed at Subhadra's son, brandishing their finest weapons.

verses.text:
तान्निवार्यार्जुनिर्बाणैः क्राथपुत्रमथार्दयत् ।
शरौघेणाप्रमेयेण त्वरमाणो जिघांसया ॥

meaning.en: Holding them off with arrows, Abhimanyu then tormented Kratha's son with an immeasurable flood of arrows, hurrying to kill him.

verses.text:
सधनुर्बाणकेयूरौ बाहू समुकुटं शिरः ।
छत्रं ध्वजं नियन्तारमश्वांश्चास्य न्यपातयत् ॥

meaning.en: He felled his bow and arrows with armlets on his arms, his head with its crown, his parasol, banner, charioteer and horses.

verses.text:
कुलशीलश्रुतबलैः कीर्त्या चास्त्रबलेन च ।
युक्ते तस्मिन्हते वीराः प्रायशो विमुखाभवन् ॥

meaning.en: When that man, endowed with family, character, learning, strength, fame and skill in weapons, was killed, the heroes mostly turned away.
